title: Allsky Clouded-Out Night Ratio
app: Raspberry Shake, Safecast, Blitzortung-compatible lightning sensors, AirGradient CO2 sensors, radon monitors, allsky cameras, and magnetometers streamed to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=allsky:capture
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(cloud_cover_pct>80)) as cloudy_frames, count as total_frames by camera _time
| eval cloudy_pct=round(100*cloudy_frames/total_frames,1)
| where total_frames>0 AND cloudy_pct>80
| sort - cloudy_pct
description: Uses Allsky camera weather context telemetry to monitor how much of each night was effectively clouded out in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for nights where astronomy data will be sparse before you waste review time, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Allsky camera weather context data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how much of each night was effectively clouded out so you can spot nights where astronomy data will be sparse before you waste review time before it becomes annoying.
